summary: Phase 4 Part 1 (Integrations Templates + Universal Edit/Email/Print) end-to-end tested. Backend Phase 4 pytest: 15/15 passed (integrations CRUD, mask preservation, MOCKED test connection, admin-only enforcement, customer/job/invoice email-sent, no vendor libs imported, seeded Q→J→INV chain intact, OpenAPI 200). Phase 1 regression: 19/20 (1 stale Phase 1 test where pricing GET is now admin-only since Phase 2 — NOT a Phase 4 regression). Frontend Playwright: admin sees nav-integrations, staff hidden + redirected; 4 cards render with all testids; M365 secret masked as ••••••••XXXX after reload; MOCKED toast on all 4 Test Connection clicks; EmailModal opens on customer/job/invoice with prefilled fields, copy buttons, Mark-as-Sent persists and last-emailed-label appears; Print buttons present on customer/job/invoice.

minor.issue: Returns 403 to staff (Phase 2/3 admin-gating change). Pre-existing Phase 1 test backend_test.py::TestPricing::test_get_pricing_any_auth still expects 200 for staff and now fails. Either tighten Phase 1 test expectation to admin-only OR re-allow staff GET. Not a Phase 4 regression — flagged for housekeeping.

action_items: (Housekeeping, NOT Phase 4 blocker) Update /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py::TestPricing::test_get_pricing_any_auth to expect 403 for staff (or use admin_headers) — pricing was tightened to admin-only after Phase 1.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1555 lines — should be split (auth, users, settings, integrations, customers, projects, jobs, invoices, quotes, calculator) before Phase 4 Part 2 to keep <700 lines/module.

Mask/secret logic: _mask_secret + _is_masked + per-section SECRET_FIELDS pattern is clean and reusable. Plaintext fields (tenant_id, sender_mailbox, api_base_url) correctly preserved; secrets correctly preserved when masked value resubmitted — verified by curl + pytest.
No real vendor libraries (msal/xero_python/graph.microsoft.com/login.microsoftonline.com/api.xero.com) referenced anywhere in server.py — confirmed via test_server_source_has_no_vendor_libs.
Test Connection endpoint is correctly admin-only (403 for staff) and returns deterministic {status:'MOCKED', integration, message} — no real HTTP fan-out.

Universal /email-sent endpoints (customers/projects/jobs/invoices) all reuse _record_email_sent helper, return 404 for unknown id, and stamp last_email_sent_at/subject/recipient/by_user_id consistently.

Frontend IntegrationSettings testid scheme is `<key>-card`, `<key>-card-test`, `<key>-card-save`, `<key>-enabled`, plus per-field `<key>-tenant-id`/`<key>-client-secret` etc. — well structured and stable for automation.

EmailModal exposes ALL specified testids (email-modal, email-recipient, email-subject, email-body, email-copy-recipient, email-copy-content, email-mark-sent) and LastEmailedLabel renders with data-testid=last-emailed-label.
Print buttons (customer-print-btn, job-print-btn, invoice-print-btn) and Email buttons (customer-email-btn, job-email-btn, invoice-email-btn) all wired and present in their detail pages.
Staff hard-block: /settings/integrations server returns 403 AND client-side redirects staff away (verified — staff direct visit lands on / and integrations-page testid is absent).

success_rate.backend: 100% on Phase 4 (15/15); Phase 1 regression 95% (19/20, 1 stale staff-pricing expectation)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (M365 mask, MOCKED test, Email modal incl. Mark-as-Sent → last-emailed-label, Print buttons, staff hidden + redirected)

seed_data_creation: Tests PUT m365 client_secret='SuperSecret1234' and then resubmit masked '••••••••1234' to verify preservation. Customer/Job/Invoice last_email_* fields are stamped on first seeded customer + J-2026-0001 + INV-2026-0001 by tests (these are append-only audit fields and are harmless to leave populated).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4 Part 1 backend regression lives at /app/backend/tests/test_phase4_integrations.py (15 tests, ~3s). Run: `pytest backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Integration card testids are `<key>-card`, buttons are `<key>-card-save` / `<key>-card-test` (NOT `<key>-save` / `<key>-test`). Login selectors: login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-button. M365 secret input uses type=text when masked so Playwright `page.fill` semantics matter — to forcefully change the secret in UI, use .click() then .press('Control+A') then .type(new_value) rather than .fill() (the masked value can otherwise be re-sent unchanged on save, which backend then preserves as designed).
rca of the issue: No Phase 4 bugs found. Single Phase 1 test failure (test_get_pricing_any_auth) RCA: pricing GET became admin-only during Phase 2 hardening; the Phase 1 test asserting staff can GET pricing is stale. Mitigation: change fixture to admin_headers or assert 403 — one-line fix in backend_test.py.
